research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Demostack is researching methods for customizing demonstrations of web-based software applications by generating demo recordings with nodes for web pages and resources, as described in 'Customizing demonstrations of web-based software applications.' They are also developing techniques for dynamic and visual recording of web-based application demos, and methods for mobile application cloning to facilitate demo creation. Additionally, they address obfuscation of personally identifiable information in demo environments.

about_short_description.short_description: Demostack provides assistance to software companies in creating, delivering, and analyzing demos.

product.name: Product Demos
product.description: A platform feature that enables GTM teams to create, customize, and deliver tailored product demos without engineering support.

product.name: Sandbox
product.description: A customizable, shareable demo environment that allows buyers to explore and test the product hands-on without engineering involvement.

product.name: Demo Cloner
product.description: A patented technology that creates fully independent demo environments mirroring the live product without backend dependencies or coding.

product.name: Overlay Demos
product.description: A demo format that customizes the live product interface by adding tailored content overlays without altering backend systems.

product.name: Mobile App Demos
product.description: A solution to demo mobile applications directly from a laptop without requiring physical devices or engineering support.

product.name: Demo Playbooks
product.description: A centralized hub that organizes demos, decks, PDFs, and product tours into customizable collections for easy access and delivery.
